properties.label: Two-by-two evidence bento
properties.text: Arrange four dark outlined feature surfaces in a 2-by-2 grid, placing each feature's copy beside or beneath its own visual evidence.

properties.label: Neutral dark feature type
properties.text: Use neutral gray typography with a clear hierarchy against graphite surfaces.

properties.label: Graphite with one lit signal
properties.text: Use a black ground, graphite surfaces, fine calibrated strokes and one small lit signal; one plate may lead in contrast while all content stays readable.

properties.label: Four distinct technical subjects
properties.text: Give the plates distinct explanatory visuals: branching concept paths, a framed scroll strip, a plotted motion curve and a resolved state change.

properties.label: Tight rimmed dark surfaces
properties.text: Use tight radii, uniform quiet borders and restrained directional rim highlights without drop shadows.

properties.label: Evidence-first plate motion
properties.text: Use motion only to explain a feature within its plate; retain a complete still frame and never require hover or focus to discover the evidence.

properties.label: Four-subject acceptance
properties.text: Reject empty icon-and-paragraph cards. Inspect each illustration and the shared line hierarchy, and preserve all four subjects on mobile.
